name: monday.com Platform MCP server
summary: monday.com's hosted Platform MCP server at mcp.monday.com/mcp lets an agent read and write boards, items, docs, forms, users and automations in a monday.com account; the vendor's reference lists 64 tools; calls count toward the account's daily API limit. Access is OAuth 2.0 or a personal API token, with the customer's own OAuth app or dynamic client registration for third-party clients. On 2026-10-19 a keyless initialize answered 401 with an RFC 9728 challenge naming a protected-resource document that hands authorization to auth.monday.com; no keyless path is documented and none was found.
license: MIT (repository); hosted under monday.com's Terms of Service

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-19: initialize to mcp.monday.com/mcp answered 401 'Not Authenticated' with a resource_metadata challenge; the protected-resource document names auth.monday.com/mcp as issuer (S256 only, DCR, CIMD, token auth none). The vendor documents OAuth 2.0 or a personal API token only.
